title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Standards for Conviction and Sentencing for the Fraudulent Issuance of Special VAT Invoices
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Standards for Conviction and Sentencing of the Crime of Issuing Falsely Special Value-Added Tax Invoices

Fa [2018] No. 226

To: All Higher People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

For the purpose of correctly applying the relevant provisions of Article 205 of the Criminal Law on the crime of issuing falsely special value-added tax invoices, and to ensure that the crime, criminal responsibility, and punishment are commensurate, the relevant issues are hereby notified as follows:

I. As of the date of issuance of this Notice, people's courts shall no longer apply, by reference in their trial work, the standards for conviction and sentencing of the crime of issuing falsely special value-added tax invoices as stipulated in Article I of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Punishing Crimes of Issuing Falsely, Forging, and Illegally Selling Special Value-Added Tax Invoices (Fa Fa [1996] No. 30).

II. Before a new judicial interpretation is promulgated and implemented, the monetary standards for conviction and sentencing in criminal cases of issuing falsely special value-added tax invoices may be implemented by reference to the provisions of Article III of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Fraudulently Obtaining Export Tax Rebates (Fa Shi [2002] No. 30). That is, where the amount of falsely issued tax is RMB 50,000 or more, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention for the crime of issuing falsely special value-added tax invoices, and shall also be fined not less than RMB 20,000 but not more than RMB 200,000; where the amount of falsely issued tax is RMB 500,000 or more, it shall be deemed as a "relatively large amount" as stipulated in Article 205 of the Criminal Law; where the amount of falsely issued tax is RMB 2,500,000 or more, it shall be deemed as a "huge amount" as stipulated in Article 205 of the Criminal Law.

The above notice shall be complied with. Any new circumstances or issues discovered during implementation shall be promptly reported to this Court.

August 22, 2018
